{{Top|leg}}
The '''Falasian liquid crystal''' was an unusual form of gemstone from the [[Falasia system/Legends|Falasia system]]. It appeared to be made from [[Liquid crystal|liquid stone]], because its wondrous patterning seemed to move and reshape itself.
